fact: The Ministry of Communication (MCPT) says the World Bank-financed DFN and EARDIP projects are deploying fibre optic networks in Djibouti-ville, Balbala and the five interior regions, with EARDIP developing terrestrial fibre along the road corridor north of Djibouti.

The Ministry of Communication (MCPT) says DFN has deployed over 200 km of fibre in Djibouti-ville and the interior regions, connecting hospitals, schools and public bodies; Ali Sabieh, 90 km south of the capital, has its regional hospital linked by it (document dated by in-text day 24 June 2025; fibre use is institutional, so the backbone reading is uncertain).
